title: Native row-sign closed comparison interface
statement: Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and a scheme $X$ over $k_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Use the actual native category of Frobenius-fixed pro-etale coefficient modules and its derived category [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define the ordinary sheaf-Hom bifunctor by precomposition and postcomposition, and the curried ordinary tensor by Mod.tensorLeft. Let $U$ be the termwise derived forgetful functor. A NativeClosedHomModels consists of native and ordinary derived Hom bifunctors, their source-slice identifications with the recorded bifunctorRHom, and natural product-total Hom models for arbitrary source and K-injective target, in the native row-sign convention. A NativeClosedComparison equips these models with closed monoidal structures, coefficient units in degree zero, symmetries, the ordinary K-flat total-tensor, unsigned adjunction normalization, and canonical localization-tensorator normalization, and invertible natural tensor and Hom comparisons for $U$. Its Compatible predicate requires the Hom arrow to be the transpose of mapped evaluation, its projectionwise representative square, tensor unit and associativity coherence, preservation of symmetry and evaluation, and naturality and preservation of the bidual arrow defined by transposing evaluation after symmetry. The final clause of NativeOrdinaryTensorModels retains the actual canonical localization normalization: there are signed balanced total isomorphisms kappa(P,Q): ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q) ≅ Q tensor P, equal on the (p,q) balanced summand to (-1)^(pq) times the canonical inclusion, and the chosen model on pairs of K-flat inputs is heterogeneously equal to the canonical lax localization tensorator followed by q(kappa inverse). This clause is satisfied by the explicit existing construction and excludes arbitrary symmetric noncocycle rescalings of the model relative to the fixed monoidal structure.

statement_change.what: The previous predicate only normalized a model relative to an arbitrary chosen closed adjunction and Hom representatives. It did not identify that model with the fixed monoidal localization tensorator. The H4 audit exposed this missing associator/unit normalization. Retain the canonical construction already used in the ordinary existence proof, rather than deriving coherence from signed symmetry alone.
